from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisites: The Plane-Cone Intersection", 
                          ["A plane slices a cone, creating distinct shapes.", 
                           "Tilting the plane changes the conic section's form.", 
                           "Circle, ellipse, parabola, or hyperbola emerge clearly."])
        
        # Hide lecture lines initially
        self.lecture.set_opacity(0)
        
        # Assets (Using SVG as provided)
        cone = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg")
        cone.set_color(WHITE)
        
        plane = Rectangle(width=2, height=0.1, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.6)
        
        cone_group = VGroup(cone, plane)
        self.place_in_area(cone_group, 'A2', 'E4', scale_factor=0.7)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture[0].set_opacity(1)), FadeIn(cone), run_time=1.5)
        self.lecture[0].set_color(BLUE)
        self.play(FadeIn(plane))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture[1].set_opacity(1)), run_time=1)
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)
        
        # Rotate plane to show ellipse
        self.play(Rotate(plane, angle=PI/4, axis=RIGHT, about_point=cone.get_center()))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(self.lecture[2].set_opacity(1)), run_time=1)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(GREEN)
        
        # Animate tilt further to show parabola
        self.play(Rotate(plane, angle=PI/6, axis=RIGHT, about_point=cone.get_center()))
        
        self.wait(2)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Points of tangency mark the conic section's focus.",
            "Equal tangent lengths define the ellipse's sum.",
            "This geometric bridge reveals the constant distance property."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("The Geometric Proof Strategy", lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors for highlights
        color_foci = "#FFD700"  # Gold
        
        # Load Assets
        cone = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cone.svg")
        sphere = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg")
        
        # Draw spheres and cone
        self.place_at_grid(cone, "C4", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(sphere, "B4", scale_factor=0.5)
        self.place_at_grid(sphere.copy(), "D4", scale_factor=0.5)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(color_foci))
        self.play(FadeIn(cone), FadeIn(sphere), FadeIn(sphere.copy()))
        
        # Ellipse and Foci
        ellipse = Ellipse(width=3, height=2, color=BLUE)
        f1 = Dot(color=color_foci)
        f2 = Dot(color=color_foci)
        
        self.place_in_area(ellipse, "B3", "E4", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.place_at_grid(f1, "C2", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.place_at_grid(f2, "C5", scale_factor=0.7)
        
        label_f1 = Text("F1", font_size=18, color=color_foci)
        label_f2 = Text("F2", font_size=18, color=color_foci)
        
        # Tethering labels (B011)
        label_f1.next_to(f1, UP, buff=0.1)
        label_f2.next_to(f2, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(Create(ellipse), FadeIn(f1, f2), Write(label_f1), Write(label_f2))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(color_foci))
        
        p = Dot(color=WHITE)
        p.move_to(ellipse.point_from_proportion(0.2))
        
        line1 = Line(p.get_center(), f1.get_center(), color=WHITE)
        line2 = Line(p.get_center(), f2.get_center(), color=WHITE)
        
        self.play(Create(p), Create(line1), Create(line2))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(color_foci))
        
        dist_text = MathTex("d_1 + d_2 = \\text{const}", font_size=24)
        self.place_at_grid(dist_text, "E4", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.play(Write(dist_text))
        
        # Trace path
        self.play(MoveAlongPath(p, ellipse), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeOut(p), FadeOut(line1), FadeOut(line2))
        self.wait(2)

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Conclusion and Application", [
            "Dandelin spheres unite 3D forms and 2D curves.", 
            "Orbits and telescope designs rely on this geometry.", 
            "Geometric insight reveals the beauty of conic sections."
        ])
        
        # Load assets
        satellite = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/satellite.svg")
        telescope = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/telescope.svg")
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Fade out Dandelin spheres leaving conic section curve.
        ellipse = Ellipse(width=3, height=2, color=BLUE)
        self.place_in_area(ellipse, "B3", "E5", scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(FadeIn(ellipse))
        self.lecture[0].set_color(YELLOW)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Morph ellipse into satellite orbit path around sun.
        sun = Dot(color=YELLOW).scale(1.5)
        self.place_at_grid(sun, "D5")
        
        self.place_at_grid(satellite, "B5", scale_factor=0.3)
        self.place_at_grid(telescope, "B2", scale_factor=0.3)
        
        orbit = Ellipse(width=3.5, height=2.5, color=BLUE).move_to(sun.get_center())
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(sun),
            FadeIn(satellite),
            FadeIn(telescope),
            Transform(ellipse, orbit),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.lecture[1].set_color(YELLOW)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Fade in labels for orbit and focus point.
        orbit_label = Text("Orbit", font_size=20, color=WHITE)
        focus_label = Text("Focus (Sun)", font_size=20, color=YELLOW)
        
        self.place_at_grid(orbit_label, "B6", scale_factor=0.9)
        self.place_at_grid(focus_label, "D4", scale_factor=0.9)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(orbit_label),
            FadeIn(focus_label)
        )
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        self.wait(2)

outline.topic: The Magic of Dandelin Spheres: Unveiling Conic Sections
outline.target_audience: High school geometry or early undergraduate students

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Plane-Cone Intersection
sections.content: Briefly define a right circular cone and the result of a plane slicing through it at different angles (the classic conic sections: circle, ellipse, parabola, hyperbola).
sections.example: Visualizing a flashlight beam hitting a wall at different angles—tilting the flashlight changes the shape of the light spot.

sections.title: Introducing the Dandelin Spheres
sections.content: Introduce the Dandelin spheres: spheres placed inside the cone such that they are tangent to the cone along a circle and tangent to the intersecting plane at a specific point (the focus).
sections.example: Imagine a snowball perfectly nestled inside a hollow traffic cone, resting snugly against the walls.

sections.title: The Geometric Proof Strategy
sections.content: Explain that the points of tangency on the plane are the 'foci' of the conic section. Use the property that tangent segments from a point to a sphere are equal in length to demonstrate why the focal property of an ellipse (sum of distances to foci is constant) holds true.
sections.example: Using a 'string and pins' analogy where the sphere tangency points act as the pins to trace an ellipse on the plane.

sections.title: Visualizing Different Conics
sections.content: Demonstrate through animation how the size and position of the spheres change as the plane's angle changes. Show one sphere for an ellipse, one for a parabola, and two spheres for a hyperbola.
sections.example: A robotic arm adjusting a cutting plane through a 3D model, with the corresponding spheres appearing and disappearing like magic.

sections.title: Conclusion and Real-World Application
sections.content: Summarize how Dandelin spheres bridge the gap between 3D cone geometry and 2D algebraic definitions. Connect this to satellite orbits and telescope design.
sections.example: A satellite (like a bird in orbit) traveling in an elliptical path where the sun is at the focus, perfectly explained by the sphere's tangency point.

issues.description: [VideoCritic][section_1] Problem: Current placement at D3 causes the cone animation to overlap with the right-side grid labels and creates a cluttered central focus. Fix: Line 57: self.place_at_grid(cone, 'B3', scale_factor=0.6) (line=57, object=cone)
